description: a gentle woman saint with long dark hair under a white veil, a thin golden halo ring behind the head, pure white robes with fine golden embroidery, a long pale gold mantle, a golden sash, a tall golden staff topped with a small white dove held upright in her right hand, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
